Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3962; fatherless, i.e. of unrecorded paternity:--without father.
BiblicalUsage: Without father — Melchizedek appears in the record with no father or mother named, no genealogy, no beginning or end of days given. The silence is the point: he stands as a picture of a priesthood that does not depend on descent.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this deliberate silence points straight to Christ, whose priesthood rests on his own endless life rather than on any family line.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
